race.comment: GANGLAND (4) was put aside after being beaten as an odds-on favourite at Ballarat synthetic early in the season. He had excuses, is stronger now, won a recent jump-out, and with the blinkers on for the first time, he can make amends. CHIX DIGGUS (3) led up and fought on gamely as the favourite fresh up here 11 days ago, finishing third by less than a length. This field is deeper, but he is fitter and can figure in the top 3 again. OUR BRAVE BOY (5) was a game fourth out of his class on the classic course here 5 weeks ago, and he is nicely poised to pick up his first win with the right run in this. PURE CROWN (6) had a couple of starts as late season juvenile against the older performers and was placed on each occasion. He resumes without any public trials, but is in good hands and is sure to be ready to run a big race fresh. Check the markets. CHAMPAGNE LADIES (7) led up and stuck on gamely for third fresh up. She will be spot on for this, so stick with her. Each way.
